[[File:Kabam Alliance Event.png|thumb]]
''Alliance events are special events for you and your [[alliance]]. Work together with your alliance and complete the required tasks to accumulate points. Contributing to the end goals of the mission makes you eligible for rewards. Reach new milestones, earn rewards, and improve your chances to get special alliance rewards together.''

''Note: Keep in mind that although alliance mission milestones and rank rewards can often be claimed by anyone in the alliance regardless of participation, some alliance events require that you participate in order to unlock these rewards.''

''Alliance events are located in the bottom-right corner of your home screen:''

=== Blackout Period ===
''There is a prize blackout period associated with alliance events and the delivery of the rewards in order to prevent the exploitation of alliance hopping. During this blackout period, alliance members will not be able to earn rewards for participating in events. This blackout impacts every player joining a new alliance, regardless of any pre-existing membership.''

''Note: Players that are kicked from their alliances by an officer will be impacted by the blackout period in the same manner as a player who chooses to leave.''

''Important: The blackout period will not be waived prematurely. Kabam's support team will not be able to adjust this in any way. Once the appropriate time frame is over, players affected by the blackout will be able to participate in new alliance events.''

Listed below is the latest rotation in chronological order.
